requirements.desc: FlowStore mutation helpers must accept opts.specId for setRequest, setIssue, addNote, appendMetric, incrementMetric, and agent metric accumulation, and must update specs/<specId>/flow.json when opts.specId is provided.
requirements.note: R1: FlowStore-backed setters update a named spec without active-flow registry

requirements.desc: FlowManager.mutate and all FlowManager setter/metric facade methods must accept an optional opts object and forward the effective specId to FlowStore.

FlowManager.forRoot(root, { specId }) must return a manager whose load(), mutate(), setRequest(), setIssue(), addNote(), appendMetric(), incrementMetric(), and accumulateAgentMetrics() use the bound specId when no per-call opts.specId is supplied.
requirements.note: R3: forRoot(root, { specId }) supplies a bound default specId

requirements.desc: When both a bound specId and per-call opts.specId exist, per-call opts.specId must select the target flow.json for that call.
requirements.note: R4: per-call specId overrides a bound specId

requirements.desc: SpecId selection must not change taskId behavior: when opts has a taskId property, null writes a flow-scope entry, a known task id writes that task id, and an unknown task id throws; when opts.taskId is absent, the entry uses state.currentTaskId or null.
requirements.note: R5: specId selection preserves explicit and inferred taskId behavior

requirements.desc: appendMetric and incrementMetric without explicit specId, bound specId, or active-flow current path must continue to no-op instead of throwing or creating a flow state.
requirements.note: R6: ambient metrics without active flow or specId remain a no-op

requirements.desc: flow set request, flow set issue, flow set note, and flow set metric must pass ctx.specId to their FlowManager mutation calls when ctx.specId is present, while preserving all existing user-facing arguments and validation.
requirements.note: R7: setter commands pass ctx.specId while preserving validation

requirements.desc: Spec-local tests must demonstrate active-flow registry independent updates for per-call specId, bound specId, CLI setter propagation, taskId preservation, and ambient metric no-op preservation.
requirements.note: R8: spec-local contract tests cover registry-independent specId updates
